savedJobs_crash.root_cause: API /api/jobs/saved returns {saved_jobs: [], count: 0} but App.js line 463 did setSavedJobs(savedRes.data) expecting an array

savedJobs_crash.fix: Extract saved_jobs array from response: setSavedJobs(savedRes.data?.saved_jobs || [])
savedJobs_crash.prevention: Add defensive Array.isArray checks in components that receive array props

tags_html_entities.prevention: Always clean/normalize data at the service layer before returning to API
